instruction: Change the slide size of the presentation to portrait orientation and save it.

command: import pyautogui; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); import time; time.sleep(2)

metadata.task_rationale: Original task tested file saving. This variation tests slide property modification (orientation change) requiring Slide menu navigation, a harder task that builds on demonstrated UI navigation ability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide orientation from landscape to portrait. Getter downloads the PPTX and reads slide dimensions. Metric checks if height > width (portrait). Postconfig saves the file before evaluation.
